research_question: What finite-scale geometry do the hidden representations of the 30 frozen Core-86 pricing networks exhibit, how does it move across layers and market states, and does the preregistered final-layer participation rank predict frozen development-period economic function after controlling for output factor count?
changes_from_parent: Apply the synthetic-validated finite-scale estimator panel to frozen P1-G1-V022 checkpoints without training or model selection.

sampling.rule: deterministic equal-count sampling within every target month; same securities are passed through all 30 checkpoints

geometry.neighbor_month_rule: every twelfth development target month starting 2010-01
geometry.primary_geometry: median development hidden3 raw-centered participation rank

functional_probe.primary_endpoint: development normalized HJ span loss from the frozen checkpoint report
functional_probe.secondary_endpoint: development factor-span Sharpe from the frozen checkpoint report
functional_probe.cross_validation: leave one common random seed out across all six factor counts
functional_probe.positive_gate: at least 5% HJ-loss RMSE improvement and two-sided within-factor-count permutation p <= 0.05
functional_probe.failure_stop: do not search alternative layers, metrics, states, or endpoints for a positive association
